design: Eight Latin-position rounds, second cycle reversed: each profile occupies each position twice, baseline/candidate order balanced four each; four excluded full warmups; no trimming or retries of valid observations

excluded_same_boundary_memory_profile.limit: Instrumented phase observations, not whole-command scope peaks; probe overhead occurs after the preserved snapshot. Independent earlier module reductions are not added.

memory_note: Dedicated scope memory.peak includes charged processes and file cache; not PHP heap or a sum of child maximum RSS values.
limits: Shared VM: external load, CPU frequency and independence uncontrolled; every valid slow observation retained
Different rules: Larastan L5 retains seven existing configuration ignores; L10 clears them but retains source annotations
No universal PHPStan-level equivalence or normalized comparison with the lost historical 600+ second epoch
One extension worker, two Mago threads, at most two PHPStan processes, fresh PHPStan caches; two-CPU/six-GiB scopes
Earlier scan-facts sources passed full501-command Composer check; both current baseline and candidate have focused native tests, not a repeated full script
